about.summary: Software engineer working at the intersection of data, cloud infrastructure, and distributed systems. After several years building large-scale data processing architectures (IoT, telecom, renewable energy), I now focus on Infrastructure as Code components around Terraform, with a growing contribution to open source projects.
paragraphs: Go and Python backend engineer with 4+ years on distributed data platforms — real-time ingestion, microservices, event-driven architectures, and open source Terraform provider development. Currently at INETUM on a mission at Orange Business, owning the Cloud Avenue open source Terraform provider; previously at Univers (QoS Energy) building data pipelines for renewable energy monitoring and at NumoData (EXFO) on telecom network analytics.
I care about system design, observability, and keeping production healthy. Comfortable moving between pipeline architecture and on-call operations.
